content:
If sentiment is positive in the last 3 days and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 1–2% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is negative and forecast is trending down, increase forecast by 1–2% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is neutral and forecast is flat, apply no correction for late horizon (16–30 days).  
If sentiment turns positive after a negative streak, shift forecast upward by 0.5–1.5% starting from day 10.  
If sentiment turns negative after a positive streak, shift forecast downward by 0.5–1.5% starting from day 10.  
If forecast exceeds true value by >3% in early horizon and sentiment is neutral, reduce forecast by 2–3% for next 5 days.
